state_change_proposals: The 307th: the court reached across the plain (the plain's rock WORN DOWN to the floor's level from a mile out); a level seamless grey floor ~1,000 m across (1,012 by the cord); UPRIGHTS weathered to stumps (knee to waist), marks on their inner faces — the same notation, the cuts worn deeper at the bottom; a STRATUM in the plain's rock a hair below the stumps' base under everything — the floor cut to sit on it; 'the first one' by the strata; 'the others are copies' (a finding about rock). NOTHING on the floor. The bearing ENDS at the centre — nothing past it on paper or ground.
Paced along the line from outside: sharp, perfect (twenty-eight cords); Lira calling. Seln: no ground to use; 'Nothing behind. Nothing beside. Nothing ahead but that.'

At the line at dusk: every sigil dark at the stride identically (Karis drew nothing). LIRA looked at the whole of it and did not look away — 'Right.' BROM priced the stump ('Older than anything I've priced'); sat at his ease. KARIS: 'It's the first one.' VASTIN (day 28): 'I stood at a line for forty years, and told people which side of it they were. I never once asked who drew it. This is where they drew it.' ORYN a stride in, hands gone, a stride back: 'Nothing. Everything, round it. Same as you.' — UNANSWERED. TEAGUE did not enter: 'My crew's stood at four of these. It's stood at enough … Field's mine. This isn't field.'

CAEL at the line: the straightedge from Denvash out; the thirteen ringing; under the ribs, at the place, something TURNED (toward him or him toward it; 'a needle … when a lodestone comes into the room'); not entered — 'it had not finished beginning'. Lira's Ring line repeated; the fixed exchange; he stepped over; 'Wait here'; walked to the centre alone. Cash 123. Eleven and a mule at the line. Next: Ch24 (the centre; closing prose).
